svg.aria-label: High level architecture of retail-supplier-warehouse. Sources: Store CSV exports (olist_orders_dataset.csv, olist_order_items_dataset.csv, olist_products_dataset.csv, olist_sellers_dataset.csv, olist_customers_dataset.csv, olist_order_reviews_dataset.csv, departments.csv). Data warehouse on PostgreSQL, 5 layers left to right. Bronze Layer: Schema bronze; Object Type Tables (8); Load Batch, full reload, Drop & create, Text, as in the file; Transformations None (as-is), Lineage columns, Bad rows to quarantine; Built by load.py. Silver Layer: Schema silver; Object Type Views (7); Load None (dbt views); Transformations Types set, Names tidied, Latest review per order; Built by dbt models/silver. Gold Layer: Schema gold; Object Type Tables (2); Load Batch, full rebuild, dbt table; Transformations Delivered, late, Seller late rank; Built by dbt models/gold. Semantic Layer: Schema semantic; Object Type Tables (5); Load Batch, full rebuild, dbt table; Data Model Star schema, 1 fact, 4 dimensions; Built by dbt models/semantic. Analytical Layer: Schema analytical; Object Type Views (3); Load None (dbt views); Transformations By month, By seller, Review by lateness; Built by dbt models/analytical. Consume: Power BI Report, powerbi/, Power Query: 5 semantic tables, Data model, DAX measures, Report: 3 pages, pages Sales, Suppliers, Late deliveries. Consume: Analysis notebook, analysis/analysis.ipynb, reads 6 tables and views. Python loads Bronze, dbt builds the layers: load.py checks the input files and loads Bronze in one transaction; dbt builds Silver, Gold, Semantic and Analytical in ref order.
svg.title: retail-supplier-warehouse high level architecture

g.text: Python loads Bronze, dbt builds the layers
load.py checks the input files and loads Bronze in one transaction; dbt builds Silver, Gold, Semantic and Analytical in ref order.
